## About
Westpoint Automotive is a car repair and maintenance shop at 6172 Barker Cypress Rd in Houston. Some families have been bringing their vehicles here since about the time the shop opened.
Customers know Mike and Diana by name. Reviewers say Mike takes time to explain repairs, gives a fair price, and keeps at a problem until it is fixed right. Nobody gets pushed into work they don't need.
We're rated 4.8 on Google from 81 reviews. Stop by on a weekday or give us a call.

## Services
- Oil changes: Routine oil changes to keep your car or truck running well.
- Repairs big and small: From small fixes to bigger jobs on your car or truck.
- Inspections: Vehicle inspections, with a clear rundown of anything you'll want to take care of down the road.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Will you tell me if a repair can wait?
A: Yes. Customers say Mike is honest about whether something needs fixing right away or can wait.

Q: Can you get my vehicle in on short notice?
A: Some customers say we've fit their truck in on the spur of the moment. Give us a call and we'll see what we can do.
